findings.evidence: screenshots/today.default.png — the right side of the 「我的预约」card header (about y=224, x≈330–358) is empty; no 「查看全部」 entry appears.
findings.issue: The 我的预约 section header lacks the required “查看全部” link, so the card has no path to the full appointment list and the header reads as unfinished.
findings.proposal: Add a right-aligned “查看全部 ›” text link in the 我的预约 card header, styled as a secondary/ghost action and routing to /appointments.

findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-list.default.png — the calendar header shows only 「周一 11-03」「周二 11-04」「周三 11-05」 three columns (about y=205–260); Thursday–Sunday have no visible entry, paging, or scroll affordance.
findings.issue: The seven-day calendar is visually reduced to three wide day columns with no cue that more days exist; the week reads as a three-day grid and Thursday–Sunday cannot be discovered.
findings.proposal: Present all seven days at a compact width, or add an explicit horizontal-scroll/page affordance with a partial next column and a week label; keep the selected/today column highlighted.

findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-list.state.loading.png — the skeleton below the filter row is a short 7-column × ~6-row bar block (about y=132–255), with no time labels or date heading, and the 「切换日历/列表」control visible in the default state is gone.
findings.issue: The loading state does not preserve the loaded calendar's structure or controls: the short 7×6 block replaces a 12-hour grid, and the date heading and view toggle vanish, so the page jumps and loses context when data arrives.
findings.proposal: Mirror the final grid in the skeleton (seven columns, hourly rows, time labels) and keep the date heading and view toggle visible but disabled during loading.

findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-list.state.empty.png — the white 「当前条件没有预约」card floats over the calendar (about y=225–365), covering the day header and the 09:00–12:00 rows while the grid below 12:00 remains visible.
findings.issue: The empty state is rendered as an overlay floating above the calendar instead of an inline state; it masks the day header and morning slots and looks like an accidental modal over the grid.
findings.proposal: Render the empty message inline in the calendar area (or directly below the legend) without covering the day headers or time axis, keeping the grid structure visible.

findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-form.default.png — below the page title 「新增/改期预约」 there are 「新增预约」「改期」 pill buttons (about y=57–88), with 「新增预约」 filled black; the reschedule screenshot leaves only a single black 「改期」pill.
findings.issue: This mode switch is not part of the page spec and reads as an internal route/debug control; it duplicates the title, competes with the form's primary action, and implies users can switch to reschedule without an appointment context.
findings.proposal: Remove the pills; use the title plus a context banner for reschedule, and let the entry point decide the mode.

findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-form.mode.reschedule.png — the 客户 field is disabled but shows the placeholder 「请输入客户」 (about y=132–172); 项目, 开始/结束时间, and 护理师 are all empty, and there is no summary of the original appointment or time slot.
findings.issue: Reschedule mode should restore the appointment; instead it presents a disabled, empty customer field and a blank form with no indication of which appointment is being changed, so the state looks broken and users cannot verify they are rescheduling the right booking.
findings.proposal: Prefill the locked customer and the appointment's current project/time/therapist, add a compact “正在改期：… 原时段 …” context, and show a skeleton or ErrorState until the document is available.

findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-form.default.png — the native 开始时间/结束时间 inputs show the English placeholder 「mm/dd/yyyy, --:-- --」 (about y=234 and y=306) inside an otherwise Chinese UI.
findings.issue: The date-time placeholders are in US English format, breaking localization and the otherwise consistent Chinese brand voice.
findings.proposal: Localize the picker/placeholder to zh-CN (for example YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm) or use the app's custom date-time control.

findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-list.default.png — the 「周三 11-05」 column header and background are identical to the adjacent days (about y=211–253); no current-day highlight is visible.
findings.issue: The current/selected day column is not highlighted, so the calendar loses its temporal anchor even though the date filter and heading both indicate 11-05.
findings.proposal: Apply a subtle selected/today tint to the 周三 column and its header, distinct from the status colors.

findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-list.state.error.png — the page shows only the centered error state (about y=340–475); the 状态/日期 filters, the view switch, and the 「日历 11-05 周三」 heading are all gone.
findings.issue: The error state drops the date/filter/view context, so the user cannot see which day or filter failed, and retry has no visible context.
findings.proposal: Keep the filter/date row and view toggle visible above the error block (disabled if necessary) so the failed query remains identifiable.

critique.summary: The b-mobile visual language is coherent and dense, and most pages are visually clean. The acceptance risk is concentrated in the appointment calendar (only three days discoverable, and loading/empty states do not preserve the grid) and the appointment form (extraneous mode pills, an empty reschedule state, and unlocalized time placeholders), with smaller context and completeness gaps on today and the list error state. Six majors and three minors; no blockers.
